requests.what: Rule 5's `recorded` check requires a gate-record line with verdict fail. GATE-TRAC-08 at M4 is recorded by BD-366 only after the KILL-SOIL decision (N18b-12, N18b-13 -> N18b-18 -> BD-366), so when a soil row fails after the repair cycle the measuring beads cannot produce that line and N18b-18 never becomes ready. Please admit a `recorded` close that cites the measuring bead's failing Gauntlet receipt (committed under receipts/gates/, every control caught, run by a session that did not implement the bead), the repair-cycle note line and the kill gate, where the gate's one recorder comes after the decision that reads the receipt. N18b-12 and N18b-13 now state this close.
